verdict.rationale: Slack's Events API is described as a way to build apps and bots that respond to activities in Slack. Apps can post into channels via chat.postMessage, and Slack offers a 'Create an agent' path. Its integrations pages describe agents like ChatGPT, Claude and Codex joining conversations as teammates. Missing for 10: no explicit documentation of mention-triggered responses (e.g. an app_mention event) or of inviting a bot user into a channel as a member, and no independent or hands-on corroboration.
